name: branding-black-logo-construction-spacing-clear-space-grid
title: Logo Clear Space and Spacing Grid
whatItIs: A light grey page with a dashed grid showing a black stepped monogram with a dot and a blocky wordmark, surrounded by clear-space measurements marked X, X/2 and X/4 and an X width arrow.
whatItMeans: Showing the spacing rules makes the logo feel systematic and protects it in use.
techniques: Dashed grid lines behind the logo
Clear space defined by fractions of the mark width
Shaded margin zones around the lockup
Simple black logo on light grey

vocabulary.definition: The empty margin required around a logo.
A measurement derived from part of the logo used to define spacing.
A fixed arrangement of symbol and wordmark.
